definitions.explanation: A protein produced by the immune system to identify and neutralize foreign substances such as bacteria and viruses. A key term in medicine, biology, and health-related discussions.

examples.japanese: ⟦ワクチン→ワクチン：05074_wakuchin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{抗体|こうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
⟦{血液|けつえき}{検査|けんさ}→血液検査：23299_ketsuekikensa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{抗体|こうたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{有無|うむ}→有無：13019_umu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: The presence or absence of antibodies was checked through a blood test.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}した→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{抗体|こうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{再感染|さいかんせん}しにくい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that people who have recovered from infection have antibodies, making them less likely to be reinfected.

notes:
USAGE:
A scientific and medical term that has become widely known through public health discussions, especially regarding vaccination and infectious disease. Commonly encountered in news reports and health-related conversations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抗体|こうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: antibodies form/develop
- {抗体|こうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have antibodies
- {抗体|こうたい}{検査|けんさ}: antibody test
- {抗体|こうたい}{値|ち}: antibody level/titer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抗原|こうげん}→抗原：17907_kougen⟧: antigen (the foreign substance that triggers antibody production)
- ⟦{免疫|めんえき}→免疫：05032_meneki⟧: immunity (the broader system of defense)
